notes: Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state. The two independently hinged overhead cabinet doors are counted as separate events; their closing order is somewhat obscured, so the two off-frame estimates are lower confidence.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both doors of the overhead cabinet above the refrigerator, then opens a wide food drawer left of the stove and a utensil drawer right of the stove. The cabinet doors and both drawers are later closed independently.
